verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly markets giving each AI agent a unique machine identity (auth0-docs-20, auth0-docs-68) via M2M Client Credentials flow with distinct Client ID/Secret and scoped tokens (auth0-docs-8, auth0-docs-25, auth0-docs-54), plus RBAC to scope permissions narrowly (auth0-docs-7, auth0-docs-39, auth0-docs-45). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of instant/one-click revocation for agent credentials, and independent hands-on validation of this specific agent-identity workflow beyond vendor docs.
